To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the binding energies of H2@C 4 GS, H2@Os C 4 GS, and H2@ W C 4 GS are -0. 21, -0. 31, and -0. 34 eV, respectively.
the adsorption energy of H2 molecule on GS doped by Os is greater than that of W doped.
the binding energy of hydrogen on graphene is enhanced by the presence of Os and W.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of hydrogen adsorption on graphene sheet and graphene sheet doped with Os and W.
the adsorption of H2 on the graphene sheet doped with transition metals.
the adsorption of H2 molecules on graphene sheets decorated with Osmium (H2@Os GS) and Tungstene (H2@W GS) at two active sites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the binding energy of the H2@Os C16 GS system was greater than that of any of the tested systems.
the binding energy of H 2@Os GS is greater than that of both H2@C 16 GS and H 2@C 4 GS and H 1@W GS.

the adsorption of H2 on the C16 site of graphene sheet was more favorable than that on C4 site, and the Os-doped graphene sheet showed a better adsorption ability for hydrogen than that of tungsten-doped one.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adsorption of hydrogen molecules on graphene sheet doped with Osmius is stronger than on graphene sheet damped with Tungsten.
the binding of H2@C 16 GS was the strongest among the studied systems.
the binding energies of H2@Cn GS (C4 and 16) were greater than H2@Mn GS (Os and W).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the binding energy of H-2 on Os GS is greater than the binding energy of the same on W GS.
, Os is more effective than W in enhancing the binding energy of H 2 on GS.
, the adsorbed systems of Os doped GS showed the highest binding energy, and therefore the highest stability, and consequently the best hydrogen storage material among the studied adsorbed systems.
